name: Not sure path reaches confirmation without keyword phrases
description: A business owner who does not know SEO phrases can continue using confirmed service and location context.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /onboard/, choose manual entry, and fill every required Business field with fictional valid data
Continue to Services and fill required core services, areas served, and differentiators
Continue to Search language and select I am not sure which keywords to use
The manual search-phrases field is hidden while priority service, customer problem, exclusions, priority locations, and competitor website fields remain available
Continue to Brand, fill the required lead notification email, and continue to Confirm
The Confirm summary says research will start from confirmed business context and does not require a manually supplied keyword phrase
